# ABREU & BRUM

ABREU & BRUM is a Brazilian cybersecurity, PenTest and consulting company. Its primary product is AB Scan, a B2B web platform for authorized security analysis of validated domains.

Primary site: https://abreubrum.com.br/

## Main Product

AB Scan helps companies validate domain ownership, run controlled non-destructive automated checks, receive professional executive and technical reports, and decide whether a manual PenTest is necessary.

The product is not an open offensive tool. Domain authorization is mandatory, with DNS TXT validation before scanning. The positioning is commercial, responsible and B2B.

## Commercial Funnel

- Explain AB Scan on the landing page.
- Use a free initial scan only when the real backend is available.
- Use the full paid scan as the path to a professional PDF report.
- Convert the paid scan amount into credit for manual PenTest for 90 days when commercially applicable.
- Position manual PenTest as a premium secondary service.

## Key Themes

- Authorized web security scan.
- Domain security analysis.
- DNS validation for scan.
- Web security report.
- Vulnerability report with evidence.
- Risk score and prioritized findings.
- Public exposure analysis.
- Supplier approval and contract security evidence.
- Manual web PenTest as a complementary service.

## Current Site Notes

This repository currently contains a static website under `app/web`. It does not include the scanner backend, checkout, login or paid report generation routes. Public copy should not link to non-existent scanner or checkout pages.
